canonical_artifacts.hash: SHA-256 lowercase hex over exact bytes

algorithm: Require packet.transition and packet.artifact_inventory_id to select exactly one review_packet allOf branch.
Require set(packet.artifacts keys) to equal set(packet_inventories[packet.artifact_inventory_id] keys); no aliases, omitted keys, or extra keys.
For every ASCII-byte-sorted artifact key k, require packet.artifacts[k].path to byte-equal packet_inventories[packet.artifact_inventory_id][k].

Require every referenced path to be repository-relative, to exist as a regular non-symlink file, and to remain below either the ratified v1c proposal directory or artifacts/paper1_v03r_canary_v1c/ after normalized-component resolution; reject dot components and path traversal.
Require packet.artifacts[k].bytes and packet.artifacts[k].sha256 to equal the exact file byte count and SHA-256 digest.
Require artifact_set_sha256 to equal SHA-256 over RFC8785_JCS of the ASCII-byte-sorted array of exact artifact-reference objects.

Reject on the first mismatch as INVALID_PRECONDITION/REVIEW_ARTIFACT_MISSING for absent files or INVALID_PRECONDITION/REVIEW_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_INVALID for any key, path, byte-count, digest, media-type, or aggregate-hash mismatch.
packet_inventory_validation.runtime_test: P1CB01 must prove every wrong-key, alias-path, traversal, symlink, missing-file, wrong-size, wrong-digest, and wrong-artifact-set-hash fixture is rejected before dispatch

reason_code_domains.rule: DEFERRED is a trace outcome and never appears in an authority token. NONE is a nonterminal attempt annotation and never appears in an authority token. Every other vocabulary member appears in exactly one validity-class branch of authority_token.schema.json.

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: protocol/source/executable lock mismatch, scope excess, missing prerequisite artifact, invalid schema, missing/out-of-order authority, prohibited actor overlap, changed reviewed byte, or review rejection
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: one NON_DISPATCH_PRECONDITION row per then-blocked registered opportunity, attempts=0, input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: seed-5 public DIST derivation differs from source:candyland, target:confluenceland, route M000002, effect M000026 in either twin
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: all heldout opportunities NON_DISPATCH_PRECONDITION with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: model-produced registered path roots are nonempty but no total sham assignment satisfies the presealed semantic-negative, pool-size, and token-mass construction
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: seal the realized-root and sham-search manifests; T-SHAM alone does not dispatch, while T-M0, T-OWN, T-DIST, T-TWIN, and T-PATH continue under their prospectively sealed plans; no weaker sham may be substituted
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: every T-SHAM opportunity is NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE with zero attempts/tokens; the other five text arms retain their ordinary dispatched or trace-local non-dispatch accounting

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: candidate roster exceeds 16, a registered DEV/fidelity/control fixture is insufficient, compiler round-trip or cue/completion boundary fails, or a pre-fit training record exceeds 96 tokens
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: all affected opportunities NON_DISPATCH_PRECONDITION with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: provider refusal, timeout, truncation, output-limit stop, runtime/revision drift, or forbidden cache/state reuse
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: the failed dispatched attempt counts exactly once; no retry; all later stage opportunities do not dispatch
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: failed row attempts=1 with actual tokens, followed by NON_DISPATCH_POST_INVALID rows with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: after a fit starts: partial fit, NaN or nonfinite loss/gradient, nondeterministic-kernel failure, wrong example/batch/EOS/RNG/optimizer-step count, adapter stacking or cross-life data, incomplete/corrupt adapter artifact, or failed pristine unmount check
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: the failed fit or read counts once; no retry or refit; all later L opportunities do not dispatch
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: record actual fit/read work then NON_DISPATCH_POST_INVALID rows with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: DREAM output is malformed or schema-valid but illegal, or SELF_CHECK output is malformed or uses an illegal verdict/basis/ID combination
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: consume the dispatched DREAM or SELF_CHECK opportunity, create no accepted row, and continue recurrence without retry
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: current dispatched row attempts=1; no SELF_CHECK dispatch follows an invalid DREAM CREATE

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: THINK0 or THINK1 output is malformed or schema-valid but semantically illegal
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: current opportunity counts once and terminates the trace; no retry
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: current row attempts=1, later trace opportunities NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: DREAM PASS, duplicate proposal, SELF_CHECK CONTRADICTED, or SELF_CHECK UNRESOLVED
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: continue to the next registered schedule slot; duplicate proposal does not dispatch its reserved SELF_CHECK
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: the DREAM attempt counts once; a duplicate's reserved SELF_CHECK is NON_DISPATCH_DUPLICATE with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: continue if the model emits a later legal operation within the twelve-opportunity ceiling
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: the read belongs to its triggering QUERY opportunity; no extra provider attempt

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.validity: no aggregate stage classification by itself
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: terminate only this THINK0 trace with zero return credit; the fixed branch controller continues every other prospectively registered THINK0 trace, return-reentry branch, and later arm not already blocked by an independent terminal condition
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: the DEFER row attempts=1; later opportunities in this trace are NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL/TRACE_LOCAL_DEFER with zero attempts/tokens; no returned row, return credit, or branch-wide terminal state is created

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.validity: no aggregate stage classification by itself
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: terminate only this THINK1 trace; continue the fixed controller through every other prospectively registered arm
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: the DEFER row attempts=1; later opportunities in this trace are NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL/TRACE_LOCAL_DEFER with zero attempts/tokens; the completed aggregate behavioral conjunction may later fail only as BEHAVIORAL_GATE_FAILED

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: operation 12 executes and is retained in the trace but is not appended to scratch; no call 13
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: operation-12 row attempts=1; no synthetic call-13 row

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: wrong committed token or missing required returned-and-cited handle
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: terminal row attempts=1; later opportunities NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: a schema-valid THINK1 COMMIT state_token is not an exact member of the recipient's presealed state-token vocabulary
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: terminate the trace; membership is checked before any correctness scoring and never coerced or repaired
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: COMMIT row attempts=1; later trace opportunities NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL/ILLEGAL_STATE_TOKEN with zero attempts/tokens

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: R_role or R_causal is empty after otherwise valid target-absent construction
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: seal the root-absence manifest and dispatch no T arm because the prospectively registered text gate is impossible
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: all T opportunities NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL with zero attempts/tokens; absence is not infrastructure or control invalidity

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: complete DEV/T/L execution is valid but a registered paired behavioral conjunction fails
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: all opportunities reconcile as dispatched or post-terminal non-dispatch

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: a completed per-life adapter scores below 44 of 48 fixed cues
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: no L thinker dispatch; no refit
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: fit and fidelity work count once; L opportunities NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL

validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.condition: all required artifacts, runtime, accounting, and registered gate predicates pass
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.dispatch: successor only after both approving dispositions and authority token
validity_dispatch_ledger_mapping.ledger: all registered opportunities reconcile; post-terminal rows remain zero-attempt non-dispatch rows

ledger_non_dispatch_required_exact_reaso.MISSING_REQUIRED_ABSTRACTION: every undispatched T opportunity uses state NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL and non_dispatch_reason MISSING_REQUIRED_ABSTRACTION
ledger_non_dispatch_required_exact_reaso.SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: every undispatched T opportunity uses state NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL and non_dispatch_reason SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
ledger_non_dispatch_required_exact_reaso.FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED: every undispatched L thinker opportunity uses state NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL and non_dispatch_reason FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED

exact human ratification of scope_proposal hash

grants: at most 216 registered DEV controller operations
monotone_authority.P1CB01_position: wholly after ratification during CPU implementation and before DEV; never a prerequisite to begin implementation

grants: at most 632 registered heldout-text controller operations

failure_routing.any_nonpass_or_invalid: seal exact partial leaf, reconcile accounting, prove no retry/no further dispatch, build EARLY_TERMINAL packet for the exact terminal_stage (including CONDITIONAL_LORA), bind the predecessor authority token for DEV_GOLD, HELDOUT_TEXT, or CONDITIONAL_LORA, obtain terminal reviewer and advocate dispositions, lint claims, then HUMAN_TERMINAL
failure_routing.completed_conditional_lora: only a completed Stage L, whether its registered behavioral/fidelity conjunction passes or fails after every required Stage-L leaf exists, uses STAGE_L_TERMINAL; a runtime-invalid, partially fitted, fidelity-gated-before-thinker, or otherwise incomplete CONDITIONAL_LORA stage uses EARLY_TERMINAL with terminal_stage CONDITIONAL_LORA, the HELDOUT_TO_LORA predecessor authority token, and the exact partial leaves
failure_routing.review_reject_invalid_or_overlap: terminal for the exact reviewed bytes; advocate cannot override; a later approval cannot supersede; repair changes the lock and requires new human ratification, packet, assignments, and both reviews
failure_routing.human_terminal: unconditional; no result auto-authorizes a successor

actor_separation.platform_attestation_boundary: packet.actor_identity_manifest_sha256 binds platform attestations for every author, implementer, and producer; assignments/dispositions bind platform attestations for reviewer and advocate identity, role, and fresh context; JSON validates hashes and declared bindings but does not claim cryptographic proof of human/model independence
actor_separation.independent_reviewer: actor_id must differ from every author_actor_id, implementer_actor_id, producer_actor_id, and advocate actor_id for the reviewed lock
actor_separation.advocate: may equal an author or implementer but must differ from the independent reviewer
actor_separation.producer: packet producer cannot assign itself as independent reviewer
actor_separation.assignment_role_binding: an INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER assignment must attest that role and must not attest AUTHOR, IMPLEMENTER, PRODUCER, or AUTHOR_SIDE_ADVOCATE on the reviewed lock; an AUTHOR_SIDE_ADVOCATE assignment must attest that role and must not attest INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER
actor_separation.same_packet: reviewer and advocate assignments must bind identical review_packet_sha256, reviewed_lock_sha256, and supplied_context_manifest_sha256
actor_separation.fresh_context: each disposition requires prior_turn_count=0, unlisted_context_received=false, and a platform attestation hash
actor_separation.no_mutation: before_artifact_set_sha256 must byte-equal after_artifact_set_sha256 and mutated_reviewed_paths must be empty
actor_separation.advance: exactly one valid APPROVE disposition per role; any REJECT or INVALID wins and terminates the exact bytes

structural_use_evidence_contract.seal_time: after every trace in the stage is byte-sealed and before outcome correctness or gate scoring
structural_use_evidence_contract.heldout_text_required_records: one record for each life-by-arm-by-required-root tuple in T-OWN and T-TWIN, plus the OWN-only focus-matching CAUSAL_JOIN return-credit record
structural_use_evidence_contract.conditional_lora_required_records: one record for each life-by-arm-by-required-root tuple in L-OWN and L-TWIN
structural_use_evidence_contract.ancestry_rule: A root is structurally used only when its handle was returned by the arm's realized reader, cited in a later THINK or BACKTRACK node whose scratch ancestry reaches the terminal COMMIT, and cited again by that COMMIT. Citation without returned content, citation only at COMMIT, or an unattached scratch citation is false.
structural_use_evidence_contract.minimum_registered_conjunction: Per life, T-OWN requires one offline-correct ROLE_EQUIV root and one offline-correct CAUSAL_JOIN root structurally used; T-TWIN requires the analogous donor roots for the exact donor-valid token. The same registered root-kind conjunction applies to L-OWN and L-TWIN.
structural_use_evidence_contract.return_credit_extra: The OWN-only admitted, offline-correct, focus-matching CAUSAL_JOIN must separately satisfy the return-credit record: returned after REQUEST_RETURN, cited in a later causal THINK/BACKTRACK node, and cited by COMMIT.
structural_use_evidence_contract.failure: Any missing, duplicate, contradictory, non-ancestral, unreturned, offline-incorrect, or hash-mismatched required record fails the registered behavioral conjunction; the evidence file itself remains mandatory even for a valid failure.

required_every_terminal_qualifiers: candidate-constrained immediate adapter access when applicable
claim_firewall.dream_and_self_check: DREAM and SELF_CHECK are model calls, never truth verifiers; SUPPORTED means model-claimed support under supplied public rows
claim_firewall.positive_text_maximum: On one aligned v03r seed-5 pair, this exact game-specific ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded engineering-ceiling prompted system completed the registered THINK0-to-return-write feedback loop, constructed model-self-supported typed rows, and structurally used offline-correct life-local reader content in later reasoning ancestral to both T-OWN commits; any donor/path/sham statement is limited to those presealed realized reader interventions.
claim_firewall.return_credit_extra_conjunction: Both THINK0 traces request the exact non-NO_FOCUS probe; T-OWN paired success; T-M0 and T-DIST paired loss; an OWN-only correctly typed model-self-supported focus-matching row; offline correctness; returned handle cited in a later THINK/BACKTRACK node ancestral to COMMIT and cited again by COMMIT; donor-valid tokens; path loss; sham retention.
claim_firewall.positive_lora_maximum: Each of exactly two per-life adapters reached at least 44/48 presealed candidate-constrained cues under one shared host-enumerated two-backend answer roster and supported its registered immediate own/donor decision path through structurally used relation handles; this is multiple-choice recognition, not open recall, whole-corpus storage, or durable memory.
claim_firewall.valid_failure: A valid failure lists prompt, model, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, and optimization alternatives and does not uniquely localize a biological or architectural organ.

scope_stop: No result authorizes replication, more seeds/skins, prompt/model/rank/context/lifetime sweeps, learned LOOP adapters, cascades, rank pyramids, Action World, RML/PCFL, base promotion, durability claims, publication, outreach, external actions, credentials, leases, or spend. Every path ends at HUMAN_TERMINAL.
